integration_overview.host: Chipset South Bridge / I/O Controller Hub (ICH)
integration_overview.topology: single host, shared LAD[3:0] + LFRAME# + LCLK + LRESET#; per-device point-to-point LDRQ#
integration_overview.init_sequence: LRESET# deasserts; host idles LFRAME# high; first activity is typically a firmware memory read to fetch the boot vector; no configuration negotiation.
